text:
nina: Hi all, accepted the org invite but I can't see a private repo I'm supposed to. I was told to check redwood/internal-guides but it doesn't appear under Repositories. I'm a Member in the org. Anyone know who to ask?

leo: Welcome Nina! Quick question: was the invite to nina@redwood.ai or an alias? We sometimes have alias mapping issues.

nina: It was to nina.personal+gh@gmail.com because I accepted from a personal account before switching to my work email. I thought the invite would merge.

maya: That explains it. If you accepted with a personal account GitHub may have created an outside-collaborator mapping or a separate member entry that doesn't get team auto-assign. Which repo exactly?

nina: redwood/internal-guides (private) — I need to push a small ops doc.

platform-bot: Onboarding check: nina (nina@redwood.ai)  SSO accepted: yes; SSH key: added; Note: detected different GitHub account email (nina.personal+gh@gmail.com) used to accept invite. Flagging for platform team.

leo: @maya can you check whether this is an outside collaborator case or if we should resend invite to nina@redwood.ai? Also check if the repo is only accessible to team members (infra-docs team).

maya: Looking now. Repo is restricted to org teams (infra-docs and docs-editors). Your personal account shows as an outside collaborator with read-only access, which is why you don't see the repo in your org repo list. Two options: (1) add your work account to the infra-docs team, or (2) remove the outside-collab and resend invite to your work account. Which do you prefer?

nina: Prefer to use my work account (nina@redwood.ai). Can you resend?

maya: Done: revoked the outside-collab on nina.personal+gh@gmail.com and sent a fresh invite to nina@redwood.ai. Also re-ran team auto-assign for nina@redwood.ai so the infra-docs team is queued. You should get an email invite.

nina: Got the invite, accepted. I still don't see the repo list updated.

leo: Small race sometimes where team assignment finishes after a minute. You can force a check by visiting https://github.com/orgs/redwood/people and looking up your handle, or run:
```bash
# requires gh auth login with work account
gh api /user/teams --jq '.[] .name'
```

platform-bot: Team-sync job enqueued for nina@redwood.ai. Expected completion: ~30s.

nina: Now I can see redwood/internal-guides and pushed the doc. Thanks! A quick doc idea: add a note to onboarding about not accepting invites from personal accounts and how to fix if you did.

onboard-bot: Logged suggestion ONB-210: add troubleshooting steps for alias/outside-collab invites and the gh api command to verify teams.

maya: Thanks for the report — we'll add it. Welcome aboard :wave:
